literature_binding.kummer_sequence: Stacks Project, Tag 03PK / Lemma 59.28.1: for n invertible, 0 -> mu_n -> G_m -> G_m -> 0 is exact on the etale site
literature_binding.torsor_H1_interpretation: Stacks Project, Tag 040Q / Lemma 59.28.5 and its torsor discussion: H^1(mu_n) classes are represented by the corresponding Kummer torsors; trivial iff a section exists
literature_binding.use_scope: Only the standard Kummer/torsor interpretation is imported. The five-root deck action, quotient map, transpose identity and projected formulas below are derived explicitly from the Stage36 equations.

five_root_cover.geometric_fiber_action: On U_BT every root is nonzero; the 32 sign choices act freely and transitively on the 32 geometric lifts of a base point.
five_root_cover.why_not: K_BT=mu_2^3 is the fixed three-coordinate twist module from 36-09CM; the full five-root deck group is mu_2^5. The bridge is the transpose quotient below, not an equality of groups.

pointwise_five_kummer_class.for_place_v: For y_v in U_BT(Q_v), Delta5_v(y_v)=([F0(y_v)],[F1(y_v)],[F2(y_v)],[F3(y_v)],[F4(y_v)]) in H^1(Q_v,G5).
pointwise_five_kummer_class.source: pull back the five product Kummer torsors w_i^2=F_i(y) along y_v
pointwise_five_kummer_class.if_y_v_lifts_to_full_cover: all five F_i(y_v) are squares, hence Delta5_v(y_v)=0
pointwise_five_kummer_class.reason: an adelic tuple may use different y_v at different places; Delta5_v(y_v) is therefore not being asserted to be the localization of one global H^1 class

transpose_quotient.target_identification: Over Q, use the standard mu_2 <-> constant Z/2 identification to regard the target as K_BT^D=(Z/2)^3 from 36-09CQ.

geometry_bound_dual_evaluation.coefficient_reduction: kappa^2, rho^2 and B^2 are global squares and disappear in Q_v^*/Q_v^{*2}
geometry_bound_dual_evaluation.why_nonconstant: On the retained parameter open P*M*D0 != 0, L=lambda^2 is nonzero and L!=1 because P^2-M^2=8D0; the displayed linear factors are distinct and occur with odd multiplicity.

cq_pairing_interface.reason: Psi_BT,v(y_v) is point-dependent and need not be the localization of one global dual class when y_v varies with v.

route_result.next_leaf_semantics: Substitute Psi_BT,v(y_v) into the CQ local Tate pairing, derive its exact squareclass/Hilbert-symbol formula, determine the finite required-place support including branch-function valuations, and test whether receiver-admissible adelic local points force or permit a nonzero total invariant. Do not call this a Brauer-Manin/Poitou-Tate obstruction before that calculation closes.
